label: Whatever has received esse has its being caused by another
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred (coverage): for every x and principle z, if x's esse is received in z (DEF-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN), then some c distinct from x causes x's being (CausesIn c x esse, the tenseless CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_3 of DEF-CAUSE-OF-PERFECTION, mode not fixed by the type). The converse direction of the reception bridge da72ae93. After the tenseless De ente c.4 principle (what has esse not from its essence has it from another; the corpus's world-indexed version is 457698e4 over DistinctEsseAt, and no bridge between DistinctEsseAt and EsseReceivedIn is built here); the reading over EsseReceivedIn is the analyst's. Timeless and untensed: it says nothing about when the cause acts. An inertialist accepts it for begun things through the originating cause (Control part 4). For a beginningless homogeneous received-esse thing, an inertialist who also accepts exercise and time symmetry must reject it, by result homogeneousConcurrentOfSymmetry and the rejection of 40a97664; Control part 1 exhibits that position.
